brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have issued demolition notices for 65 apartments and villas in Hebron despite their legal licensing, Shehab Wire reported. The move threatens dozens of families with displacement in what rights groups characterize as collective punishment.

The demolition orders target residences that Palestinians say possess proper authorization, raising questions about the legal basis for the notices and the occupation's enforcement practices in the city.

title: Israeli occupation issues demolition orders for 65 licensed homes in Hebron
